question:
Which of the following letters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

B, D, G, K, P, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3cf684fc9c82a90ebdaae30f16bf56cc2b36c5a153e5a41cc8460a0e2f84635.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bf83cb4b89175c22345fe418d12c1607b676f81654a9ffff59a5d36788dab2d.png] 

So, 'V' will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
